sections.Overview:
Travel to the distant moon of Lumina in the far-off Namdron Galaxy as the newest member of the Galactic Tank Force. Tasked with patrolling and protecting the recently established lunar research base, your mission is to defend it from the ruthless Empress Annoya and her invading forces. Experience challenges and close calls from far, far away as you embark on this incredible journey through space and time!
Take control of the Model 375A Battle Tank and fend off massive enemy tanks, robots, and UFOs, all sent by the evil Empress Annoya to destroy you. Feel the rumble of approaching enemy tanks and prepare to face them head-on with Major Duke Moonwalker guiding and supporting you from the orbiting space station.

sections.Highlights:
American Pinball is rolling out the final GTF’s with a bang! We’re celebrating the final run of Galactic Tank Force (first launched in 2023) with a new updated model: The Victory Edition .
Just 100 units will be available and each will be individually numbered . This final production run of Galactic Tank Force packs exclusive upgrades, including a redesigned, fully interactive tank sculpt and a stunning new topper – all at the same $8995 price as the previous deluxe (standard) edition.
Features an exclusive Galactic Blue armor package, complemented by new custom blue apron and shooter lane decals. The apron artwork showcases your unique unit number alongside a pin up photo of fan-favorite Captain Kyan .
Designed by original game artist Chris Franchi , this dual-panel acrylic topper features Captain Kyan lit by a dedicated LED strip.
Also available separately for current GTF owners
Hand-painted and resin-cast by our partners at The Art of Pinball , this revamped tank looks better and plays harder. It retains the signature motorized action while adding 3 embedded interactive LEDs that react during game modes and attacks.
Standard equipment includes interior side art, a shaker motor, AURA Lighting, Magic Glass, and a physical knocker. The cabinet artwork, translite, and core playfield feature the same setup of the now-retired Deluxe Edition.
sections.Massive Code Update & 3D Print Files:
Includes new Extra Balls, the long awaited Tank Zulu mini-wizard mode , new held-flipper status screens, fresh tank light shows, resume skill shot after air-strike ball locks, improved ball-save grace periods, new callouts, and the ability to disable the left magnet with the 3rd flipper button when mystery or lock is lit!
You can now download the original STL files for the UFO, Spybot, and robot sculpts. Print and hand-paint your own game mods using your 3D printer!
